name: 黃少谷

decisions.reason: Inspected actual 600x720 JPEG and all five PNG stages. Single face, both eyes open, no microphone/second face/watermark; dim background and purple cast but facial detail usable. Eyes and nose stages acceptable; mouth reveal bottom 0.58 shows chin already, and chin stage 0.68 exposes neck. Supersede with tighter mouth/chin masks; do not approve V1.

stageVisualReview.eyes: pass: both eyes visible; mouth and nose tip hidden
stageVisualReview.nose: pass: nose tip near bottom, lips hidden
stageVisualReview.mouth: fail: bottom includes chin too early
stageVisualReview.chin: fail progression: extra neck revealed after chin already shown
stageVisualReview.full: single recognizable face, moderate softness and purple light; no extra face or watermark
